proposals.title: Implement packages/core: ADRs, branded types, RNG, CanonicalEncoder
proposals.why_now: Every other FASE-1 deliverable depends on packages/core. The spec explicitly mandates that ADR-009 be written and the CanonicalEncoder implemented before any StateHash can exist. The hash function required by ADR-002 is a DEFINIR item that must be specified in an ADR before implementation begins. Currently every package is a stub export with zero production code. No hash, no RNG, no nominal types, and no canonical encoding means INV-01, INV-02, INV-12, INV-22, INV-23 cannot be tested and world, domain, application, and replay CLI cannot be built correctly. This is the single hardest blocker in the repository.

proposals.title: Electron desktop scaffolding: secure BrowserWindow, worker separation, minimal UI, installer
proposals.why_now: The spec states explicitly in §14.6 that the installer must exist in FASE-1 in minimal form and warns that deferring Electron bootstrap until later causes ABI and native-module issues to surface too late to fix. INV-29 (contextIsolation active, nodeIntegration off, sandbox active) is a FASE-1 acceptance criterion. The simulation worker separation from the renderer thread is a locked architectural requirement. Crucially, this work has no dependency on packages/core and can proceed in parallel with IDEA-001, maximizing throughput.

proposals.title: Implement packages/world price generator: 2 assets, 2 noise layers, O(1) at any tick
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 requires a price generator covering at least two assets (ORB and NEXA) with two octave layers of fractal noise. With packages/core in place this becomes buildable. The trendLayer and idiosyncraticNoise must be positional so price(asset, tick) is O(1) and yields the same value whether reached directly or tick-by-tick, satisfying INV-02. Octave count, periods, and amplitudes are DEFINIR items requiring an ADR before any numbers are embedded in the engine.

proposals.title: Implement packages/domain: double-entry ledger, spot market orders, INV-04 through INV-07
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 requires a multi-commodity double-entry ledger and market-order execution for spot buy and sell. Without these, the canonical tick loop and save/replay cannot be tested end-to-end, and INV-04 through INV-07 remain unverifiable. The ledger is the economic core that all gameplay depends on. rounding residue correctness (INV-07) and per-commodity balance closure (INV-04, INV-05, INV-06) are not testable until domain is implemented.

proposals.title: Implement tick loop, save/load (ADR-006), and tools/replay CLI
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 requires the canonical 10-step tick processing order implemented in a single readable location in packages/application, a save file conforming to ADR-006 (seed + action log + finalTick), and a tools/replay CLI that compares two executions and reports the first divergent tick. Without these, INV-01 (replay purity) and INV-21 (finalTick invariant) cannot be verified, and the §17 CI gate requiring three reference-game replay comparisons cannot be satisfied. These are the capstone deliverables that validate end-to-end FASE-1 correctness.

repository_assessment.current_state: Monorepo bootstrap is complete (TASK-0002 accepted): all 16 mandated npm workspaces exist, strict TypeScript configuration, ESLint determinism-enforcement rules, dependency boundary checker, CI workflow, and 44 passing tests for lint/boundary/config are in place. Every package source file is a stub `export {}`. No ADRs have been written, no production logic exists, and no invariant tests are present.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: packages/core has zero implementation and zero ADRs. The spec explicitly requires ADR-009 (CanonicalEncoder) to be written and the encoder implemented before any StateHash can exist. The hash function for ADR-002 is DEFINIR and must be registered in an ADR before rand() is implemented. No nominal types, no RNG, no hash, and no canonical encoding means every other FASE-1 deliverable is blocked.

warnings: ADR-009 is an explicit prerequisite gating all StateHash work: the spec states the encoder must be implemented before any StateHash exists. Any implementation that produces a hash before ADR-009 is recorded is a direct spec violation.

The hash function for ADR-002 is DEFINIR. Implementing rand() before registering the algorithm bit-by-bit in an ADR embeds an unregistered number with determinism effect, violating §19 and §16 item 7.
ADR-004 rounding enforcement mechanism is DEFINIR. Domain arithmetic written before this ADR exists cannot satisfy the compile-time or lint-time enforcement the spec requires.

tools/bench calibration ratios must be frozen in FASE-1 (§18 baseline protocol). These ratios cannot be frozen until packages/core and packages/world are implemented. bench work is sequentially blocked by IDEA-001 and IDEA-003 but must not be deferred past FASE-1 acceptance.

The transcendental-function prohibition in §13 combined with the price generator's need for logarithmic and exponential operations creates an implementation constraint: fixed-point or lookup-table implementations of these functions must be specified before packages/world arithmetic is written, and the approach should be captured in an ADR.
